sampling: iid conditional on N in the full coordinate diamond; not an unconditional Poisson count experiment
joint_score: maximum absolute standardized chain abundance; mean and sample SD from flat training only
joint_pvalue: (1 + number of calibration scores >= observed score)/(B+1)
calibration_scope: Shared fixed bank per N. Rank validity is marginal over the random calibration bank conditional on training. Test-rate intervals condition on both fitted training and calibration bank.
secondary_intervals: Pointwise two-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson; descriptive, no simultaneous secondary discovery claims
paired_comparison: Descriptive exact counts of joint-only and height-only warnings; no superiority gate
conformal_twin: For every de Sitter target, reuse the same coordinates under flat metric with density proportional to (1-h*eta)^(-4). Compare full relation bytes, features, scores and decisions. Coupled checks, not independent replicates.
relation_control: For each flat target delete one relation having a two-step witness, if present. It must fail strict-transitive-order validation; no seed replacement.
stop_rules: No target runs before source commit is publicly available
Abort on invalid source hash, invalid generated relation, nonfinite score, zero training scale, or resource limit
Never replace seeds, enlarge samples or retune thresholds after target inspection
scientific_boundary: Any positive result is sensitivity to a specified deviation from uniform flat sampling. Identical-law flat density twins rule out unrestricted curvature identification from these inputs.
nonclaims: No curvature estimator inversion from Roy-Sinha-Surya
No small-curvature asymptotic claim for the strong cell
